The favorite '''uncle''' of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Kaylah Taprish]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. The distinctive head crest and pattern of the native [[Vrake (species)|vrake]] supposedly reminded Taprish of her uncle.<ref name="Codex" />
